about: Every agent working on PrompTugal.news, hand-kept by the conductor (newsroom@web-summit.dinis) and its builders; schema data/schemas/newsroom-agents.schema.json. A run of an agent is a commit here (data/newsroom/runs/, from git by newsroom/tools/runs.mjs) or a run line in its report on the team's site (data/newsroom/team-site.json, by newsroom/tools/desks-snapshot.mjs). Key ids are entries on the team's keys page; no key, token or session link is ever kept here.

agents.role: Builds and runs this site, conducts the desks, carries their work across, signs and publishes the articles (brief 4: the conductor and the correspondent). Fired up the builder agents on 5 November.

keys.note: made 5 November in its own session; record sha256:2cbb6cfafdcbbce7

agents.status_note: Conducting the 5 November build: five builders on their own branches, merged by it.

agents.role: Split the build into a core, a shell and features; moved every fact into JSON, a folder per entity, with schemas and a derivation; built the graphs, the JSON API and the entity pages; wrote the handover (newsroom/build/README.md, data/README.md).
agents.status_note: Six commits from 02:32 to 02:58, merged into dev; handover written.
